functions.name: remove-member-from-space
functions.description: Remove a configured member and their assigned space roles without deleting the person's account or meeting history.

memberId.description: Full configured-member resource ID whose membership and assigned roles to remove.
Full member ID targeted by the successful removal request.

requestAccepted.description: Meet acknowledged removal; does not certify any current attendee was ejected.

FunctionOutput_google_meet_removememberf.description: Acknowledgment of the configured membership removal request.

tags.instructions: Use memberId from `list-space-members`. This removes configured membership, not a participant session, and is not a command to eject a current attendee. To configure the person again use `add-member-to-space`; retaining the old membership ID is not guaranteed.

functions.name: update-space
functions.description: Partially update a meeting space's access, moderation, attendance-report, and automatic-artifact settings.

spaceId.description: Canonical case-sensitive space ID, not a meeting-code alias; obtain with get-space.

accessType.description: Access policy controlling who joins without knocking.

moderation.description: Moderation mode; OFF also resets moderation restrictions to defaults.

autoRecording.description: Automatic recording when someone with recording privilege joins.

autoSmartNotes.description: Automatic organizational smart notes when a privileged person joins.

chatRestriction.description: Who can chat when moderation restrictions apply.

autoTranscription.description: Automatic transcription when someone with transcription privilege joins.

presentRestriction.description: Who can share their screen when moderation restrictions apply.

defaultJoinAsViewer.description: Default viewer-role restriction when moderation restrictions apply.

reactionRestriction.description: Who can send reactions when moderation restrictions apply.

settings.description: Partial settings patch. Omission leaves a field untargeted; null and empty strings are rejected. UNSPECIFIED values explicitly send the provider sentinel, not a guaranteed reset.

FunctionInput_google_meet_updatespace.description: Canonical meeting space and the nonempty partial settings patch to apply.

id.description: Canonical spaces/{space} ID of the updated space.

settings.description: Provider-returned settings after the update; absent leaves are not inferred.

meetingUrl.description: Provider joining URL; omitted if unavailable.

meetingCode.description: Current temporary joining-code alias; omitted if unavailable.

phoneAccess.description: Regional dial-in methods if returned; empty and absence remain distinct.

pin.description: Dial-in PIN as text, preserving leading zeros.

phoneNumber.description: E.164 dial-in number with leading plus sign.

gatewaySipAccess.description: SIP gateway joining methods if returned; empty and absence remain distinct.

uri.description: Provider sip: or sips: joining URI.

sipAccessCode.description: Permanent numeric manual-entry code as text.

activeConferenceRecordId.description: Active conference record reference; omitted if none is returned.

FunctionOutput_google_meet_updatespace.description: Updated meeting space returned by Meet, with only provider-returned settings and joining details.

tags.instructions: Get a canonical id from `get-space` or `create-space` first. Only supplied settings are targeted. Turning moderation OFF resets moderation restrictions to defaults. Automatic-artifact settings do not immediately start generation. Use `end-active-conference` to end a call instead.

functions.name: update-space-member
functions.description: Partially update a configured space member's email or meeting role.

memberId.description: Full configured-member resource ID to modify.

email.description: New member email, sent unchanged; omitted to leave email untargeted. Null and empty are not supported clearing commands.

role.description: New provider role value; omitted to leave role untargeted. ROLE_UNSPECIFIED retains provider sentinel semantics, not guaranteed demotion or removal.

email.description: New member email, sent unchanged; omitted to leave email untargeted. Null and empty are not supported clearing commands.

role.description: New provider role value; omitted to leave role untargeted. ROLE_UNSPECIFIED retains provider sentinel semantics, not guaranteed demotion or removal.

FunctionInput_google_meet_updatespacemem.description: Configured membership to update, with at least one supplied email or role.

role.description: Returned configured role; omitted if unavailable.

email.description: Member email returned by Meet after update; omitted if unavailable.

tags.instructions: Use memberId from `list-space-members`. Only supplied fields are targeted. ROLE_UNSPECIFIED sends the provider's sentinel and is not a promise to remove membership; use `remove-member-from-space` for removal.
